mentions.name: Online guidance solver for KSA
mentions.description: This online guidance solver lets you control a Kitten Space Agency (KSA) rocket from the command line for a variety of maneuvers such as launch and rendezvous. It uses successive convexification to turn the full nonlinear trajectory problem into a sequence of convex problems with linear constraints and quadratic objective. Planned follow-on experiments include full mission planning, Falcon-9-style ascent with split control, and vehicle swarms.
